about_the_game:
Step into the chaos of Roguie, a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled boomer shooter inspired by retro classics.

Featuring four unique worlds with randomized stages:

  • Space: Fight to survive against alien lifeforms seeking to overtake your ship.

  • Dungeon: Slash through the undead and vermin inside twisted catacombs.

  • Tombs: Loot cursed tombs while battling mummies and rival raiders.

  • Feudal Japan: Slice through shinobi and man-eating yokai in a haunted palace.

Unlock four playable characters, each with their own unique abilities and playstyles, and master a variety of weapons and items to annihilate anything in your path.

Key Features

  • Four distinct, randomized worlds to conquer

  • Single-player and multiplayer mayhem

  • Four playable characters with unique abilities

  • Fast-paced combat and brutal action reminiscent of classic titles in the genre

  • A variety of randomly rolled weapons, items, and upgrades to make every run unique

content_descriptors.notes: Roguie contains stylized violence with dismemberment and gore involving human and monster enemies. Some levels feature sake bottles, though no alcohol consumption is shown.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Fight your way through space and time — alone or with friends — in this fast-paced roguelike shooter.
